title: Indian Army Agniveer GD Full Length Mock Test 15 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Army Agniveer GD (CEE). 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Advanced challenging questions based on latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions (General Knowledge 25, General Science 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning 25).
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Official CEE GD pattern 50 questions ka hota hai; yeh extended full-length practice set hai.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the first and last Indian Governor-General of independent India (1948-1950).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Battle of Buxar was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Buxar was fought on 22 October 1764 between the British and the combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875 in Bombay.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Dandi March was started by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Salt Satyagraha / Dandi March began on 12 March 1930 from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The concept of Fundamental Duties was borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment (1976) and were inspired by the Constitution of the USSR.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does not pass through which of the following states?
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram. It does not pass through Odisha.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The highest peak of the Eastern Ghats is?
questions.explanation: Arma Konda (also known as Sitamma Konda) in Andhra Pradesh is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is known as the Father of Indian Planning?
questions.explanation: M. Visvesvaraya is regarded as the Father of Indian Planning for his book 'Planned Economy for India' (1934).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The First Five Year Plan was based on which model?
questions.explanation: The First Five Year Plan (1951-56) was based on the Harrod-Domar model.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the highest gallantry award in India during peacetime?
questions.explanation: Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award, equivalent to Param Vir Chakra (wartime).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The headquarters of the Indian Army is located at?
questions.explanation: The Integrated Headquarters of the Ministry of Defence (Army) is in New Delhi.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is the current Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India (as of 2026)?
questions.explanation: General Anil Chauhan is the current Chief of Defence Staff of India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal was?
questions.explanation: Abhinav Bindra won the individual gold in 10m Air Rifle at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Nobel Prize in Literature 2024 was awarded to?
questions.explanation: South Korean author Han Kang was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The classical dance form 'Kathakali' originated in which state?
questions.explanation: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama form that originated in Kerala.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who was the last Viceroy of India?
questions.explanation: Lord Louis Mountbatten was the last Viceroy of India (1947) and the first Governor-General of independent India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the Sorrow of Bihar due to its frequent flooding and changing course.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Right to Education is a Fundamental Right under which Article?
questions.explanation: Article 21A (inserted by 86th Amendment) makes free and compulsory education for children aged 6-14 a Fundamental Right.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Operation Meghdoot was related to?
questions.explanation: Operation Meghdoot (1984) was the Indian Army operation to secure the Siachen Glacier.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which country hosted the G20 Summit in 2023?
questions.explanation: India hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi in September 2023.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: GST was implemented in India from which date?
questions.explanation: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented across India on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar, Punjab.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The SI unit of electric charge is?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of electric charge is the Coulomb (C).

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction, hence it is a vector quantity.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The phenomenon of light bending around the edges of an obstacle is called?
questions.explanation: Diffraction is the bending of light waves around the corners of an obstacle or aperture.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The atomic number of an element is equal to the number of?
questions.explanation: Atomic number (Z) equals the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which gas is used in the preparation of bleaching powder?
questions.explanation: Bleaching powder is prepared by the action of chlorine gas on dry slaked lime.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The hardest naturally occurring substance is?
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural substance.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouse of the cell because they produce ATP.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which vitamin is also known as Ascorbic acid?
questions.explanation: Vitamin C is chemically known as ascorbic acid and is water-soluble.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The process of photosynthesis takes place in which part of the plant cell?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Sound waves cannot travel through?
questions.explanation: Sound waves require a medium to travel and cannot travel through vacuum.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: pH value of pure water is?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral with a pH of 7 at 25°C.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: Blood group O negative is considered the universal donor.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is?
questions.explanation: A barometer is used to measure atmospheric pressure.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The chemical formula of washing soda is?
questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate (Na2CO3·10H2O).

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The largest gland in the human body is?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland and the largest internal organ in the human body.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which colour of light has the highest wavelength?
questions.explanation: In the visible spectrum, red light has the longest wavelength and lowest frequency.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The element with atomic number 1 is?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen has atomic number 1 and is the lightest element.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which part of the human brain controls balance and coordination?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum is responsible for balance, coordination and fine motor control.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The unit of frequency is?
questions.explanation: Frequency is measured in Hertz (Hz), which is cycles per second.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which of the following is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Argon is a noble gas (Group 18) with a complete outer electron shell.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The disease caused by deficiency of Vitamin D is?
questions.explanation: Deficiency of Vitamin D causes rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Ohm's law is related to?
questions.explanation: Ohm's law states that V = IR, relating voltage, current and resistance.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The process of converting solid directly into gas is called?
questions.explanation: Sublimation is the phase transition from solid to gas without passing through the liquid phase.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which organelle is known as the 'suicide bag' of the cell?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes contain digestive enzymes and are called suicide bags because they can cause autolysis.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately?
questions.explanation: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10^8 m/s.

questions.explanation: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 49 = 154 cm².

questions.explanation: Volume = side³ = 4³ = 64 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. The net change is?
questions.explanation: Net effect = 20 - 20 - (20×20)/100 = -4% (decrease).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The smallest number which when divided by 12, 15 and 20 leaves remainder 3 in each case is?
questions.explanation: LCM of 12, 15 and 20 is 60. The required number is of the form 60k + 3. For k=1, 63. 63 ÷ 12 = 5 rem 3, 63 ÷ 15 = 4 rem 3, 63 ÷ 20 = 3 rem 3. Hence 63.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A person covers 120 km in 3 hours. His speed is?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance/Time = 120/3 = 40 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The average of 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 is?
questions.explanation: Sum = 75, average = 75/5 = 15.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In a right-angled triangle, if one angle is 30°, the other acute angle is?
questions.explanation: Sum of acute angles = 90° ⇒ other angle = 60°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Perimeter of a square of side 8 cm is?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 4 × side = 32 cm.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If CAT is coded as 3120, how is DOG coded?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Book : Read :: Pen : ?
questions.explanation: Book is used to read; Pen is used to write.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of woman's mother is the woman herself. So she is the mother of the man.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km North, then 3 km East, then 5 km South. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He is 3 km East of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 15th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = Total - left position + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11
questions.explanation: 9 is not a prime number; others are prime.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What comes next: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: Squares of natural numbers: 1²,2²,3²,4²,5²,6²=36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, PAPER is written as QBQFS. How is PEN written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P+1=Q, A+1=B, P+1=Q, E+1=F, R+1=S. PEN → QFO.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: India : New Delhi :: Japan : ?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the capital of India; Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is the brother of B who is sister of C. So A is uncle of D (C's child).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West, then what will West become?
questions.explanation: The directions have rotated 135° clockwise. West becomes South-East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 17, 23, ?
questions.explanation: Common difference +6: 23+6=29.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which is the odd one: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Mango
questions.explanation: Carrot is a vegetable; others are fruits.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 50, Ravi ranks 15th from the top. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = 50 - 15 + 1 = 36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If in a code, DELHI is written as 73541, how is CALCUTTA written?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: Doctor works in Hospital; Teacher works in School.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Complete: Z, X, V, T, R, ?
questions.explanation: Reverse alphabet skipping one: Z,X,V,T,R,P.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If A is the son of B, B is the daughter of C, C is the husband of D, then how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: B is daughter of C and D (C's wife). So D is grandmother of A.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person starts from point A, walks 4 km East to B, then 3 km North to C. Distance from A to C is?
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras: √(4²+3²)=5 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following is the odd one out: Dog, Cat, Cow, Lion, Tiger
questions.explanation: Cow is a herbivorous domestic animal; the others (Dog, Cat, Lion) are carnivorous.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What is the next term: 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
questions.explanation: Each term ×3: 81×3=243.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a code language, 'MANGO' is written as 'NBOHP'. How is 'APPLE' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: A+1=B, P+1=Q, P+1=Q, L+1=M, E+1=F ⇒ BQQMF.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: Pen is used to write; Knife is used to cut.
